technology_name: Synthetic Dura Substitute for Duramater Repair
institution: Sree Chitra Tirunal Institute for Medical Sciences and Technology (SCTIMST)
problem_solved: Dura mater defects and cerebrospinal fluid leakage following neurosurgical procedures
description: The synthetic non-degradable dura substitute is developed for repairing defects in the dura mater following neurosurgical interventions. The electrospun polycarbonate urethane material acts as a temporary or permanent prosthesis, helping restore the anatomical barrier and reduce complications associated with cerebrospinal fluid leakage.
applications:
Neurosurgery hospitals and specialty neurological care centers
Medical device and biomaterial manufacturing companies
Cranial and spinal surgery healthcare providers
Research institutions and biomedical engineering organizations
Defence medical services and advanced trauma care facilities
